record.title: Reconcile exact stock bandwidth policy with the RF contrast
record.intent: Recover which software signal-path selections distinguish enums17 and18 before a physical policy comparison.
requirements: Rehash the preserved stock ELF and pin symbol/data provenance before analysis. Reconcile prior local three-way findings against the exact stock ancestor used by the specimen-derived experiment, preserving older artifacts and stock bytes.

Recover enum17/18 selections in UpdateBandLimit and SetBandLimit under declared4GSa/s normal acquisition and50-ohm conditions; trace analog tuple sources, digital filter IDs and coefficient payload identity, cache checks and scale/offset refresh. Distinguish constructor defaults, persisted calibration, runtime selectors and unestablished native scale/channel-mode units.

Use static-first recovery and only bounded offline instruction execution where ambiguity requires it. Do not rerun an exhaustive old matrix or contact any physical device. Pin exact controlled inputs/stubs and retain unexpanded dependencies; a predicted software selection is not a live hardware witness.

Produce a sanitized TOML contract and report relating verified software differences to the proposed RF contrast, with exact remaining bench questions. Independently check important instruction/table claims and changed-evidence controls; commit and push the bounded result or precise unresolved boundary.
acceptance: Exact software selection evidence or its bounded unresolved inputs inform the next comparison without promoting static or synthetic behavior into physical validation.
